IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeviceTokensTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.MobileDeviceTokensTbl ( TokenID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_MobileDeviceTokensTbl PRIMARY KEY, TokenHash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, UserName NVARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, PersonID INT NULL, DeviceId NVARCHAR(128) NULL, DeviceName NVARCHAR(128) NULL, AppVersion NVARCHAR(32) NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileDeviceTokens_CreatedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), LastUsedAt DATETIME NULL, ExpiresAt DATETIME NOT NULL, RevokedAt DATETIME NULL, RevokedBy NVARCHAR(256) NULL );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_MobileDeviceTokens_TokenHash ON dbo.MobileDeviceTokensTbl (TokenHash); CREATE INDEX IX_MobileDeviceTokens_UserName ON dbo.MobileDeviceTokensTbl (UserName); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl ( ProofID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_MobileDeliveryProofTbl PRIMARY KEY, ClientRef NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, OrderID INT NOT NULL, ContactID INT NULL, PersonID INT NULL, UserName NVARCHAR(256) NULL, Outcome VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileDeliveryProof_Outcome DEFAULT ('Delivered'), ReceivedByName NVARCHAR(128) NULL, SignatureImage VARBINARY(MAX) NULL, SignatureContentType VARCHAR(32) NULL, DriverNote NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, DeliveredAt DATETIME NOT NULL, Latitude DECIMAL(9,6) NULL, Longitude DECIMAL(9,6) NULL, Status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileDeliveryProof_Status DEFAULT ('Received'), StatusMessage NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, ReceivedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileDeliveryProof_ReceivedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), CompletedAt DATETIME NULL, CompletedBy NVARCHAR(256) NULL );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_MobileDeliveryProof_ClientRef ON dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl (ClientRef); CREATE INDEX IX_MobileDeliveryProof_Order ON dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl (OrderID, DeliveredAt DESC); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileSyncRefTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.MobileSyncRefTbl ( ClientRef NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_MobileSyncRefTbl PRIMARY KEY, Kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, EntityID INT NOT NULL, UserName NVARCHAR(256) NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileSyncRef_CreatedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()) ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileApiRequestLogTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.MobileApiRequestLogTbl ( LogID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_MobileApiRequestLogTbl PRIMARY KEY, LoggedAt DATETIME NOT NULL, Method VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, Path NVARCHAR(400) NOT NULL, StatusCode SMALLINT NOT NULL, DurationMs INT NOT NULL, RequestBytes INT NULL, ResponseBytes INT NULL, UserName NVARCHAR(256) NULL, TokenID BIGINT NULL, ClientIp VARCHAR(45) NULL, UserAgent NVARCHAR(256) NULL, Note NVARCHAR(500) NULL );
CREATE INDEX IX_MobileApiRequestLog_LoggedAt ON dbo.MobileApiRequestLogTbl (LoggedAt); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl ( OptionID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl PRIMARY KEY, Outcome VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, OptionText NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, NeedsName BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileDeliveryOptions_NeedsName DEFAULT (0), SortOrder INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileDeliveryOptions_SortOrder DEFAULT (100), IsEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileDeliveryOptions_IsEnabled DEFAULT (1) );
INSERT INTO dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl (Outcome, OptionText, NeedsName, SortOrder) VALUES ('Delivered', N'Handed to the contact', 1, 10), ('Delivered', N'Handed to an assistant', 1, 20), ('Delivered', N'Left at reception', 1, 30), ('Delivered', N'Left with security', 0, 40), ('Delivered', N'Left at the gate', 0, 50), ('Delivered', N'Left at the door', 0, 60), ('Delivered', N'No signature obtained', 0, 70), ('NotDelivered', N'Nobody there', 0, 10), ('NotDelivered', N'Closed', 0, 20), ('NotDelivered', N'Rejected / refused', 0, 30), ('NotDelivered', N'Asked for another day', 0, 40), ('NotDelivered', N'Wrong address', 0, 50), ('NotDelivered', N'Could not get access', 0, 60), ('NotDelivered', N'Ran out of time', 0, 70); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl ( SettingsID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_MobileApiSettingsTbl PRIMARY KEY, RunDoneOnDelivery BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileApiSettings_RunDone DEFAULT (0), SendDeliveryConfirmation BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileApiSettings_SendConfirm DEFAULT (0), AllowNotesToOffice BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileApiSettings_NotesToOffice DEFAULT (1), OfficeEmail NVARCHAR(200) NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MobileApiSettings_UpdatedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); END
